domain_claim: For bytes that match the VBSE magic but whose 5th byte is not SLOT_WRITTEN_EXTRA_VERSION, decode_slot_written_extra returns Err(VersionMismatch { found: bytes[4] }) and never returns Ok(LegacyFrameExtra(_)). This is the actual bug fix.
model_boundary: symbolic bytes of length up to KANI_BOUND_BYTES = 256; first 4 bytes fixed to b"VBSE"; bytes[4] kani::any() excluding 0x01; bytes[5..] kani::any()

Kani harness: fix bytes[0..4] == MAGIC, kani::any() for bytes[4] with kani::assume(version != 0x01), kani::any() for the rest; assert output is Err(VersionMismatch { found: bytes[4] }) exactly. Crucially, no Ok(LegacyFrameExtra(_)) may be reachable. Flux-RS: refinement type constraints the discriminator. proptest: reject any input producing Ok(LegacyFrameExtra) when bytes[0..4] == MAGIC.
